summary:
A 24-wide pale limestone slab (white_terracotta) set narrow-end east toward the plaza and rising to a flat 8-wide crown at y232. Its north and south flanks step back in 2-block ledges (212→218→222→224→228→232), and at the east end they cascade down (196→153→110→41), following the lidar roof map. Every face is fluted with 1-wide piers and recessed dark window strips; it has Top of the Rock glass-parapet decks, a red "GE" sign, a floodlit crown, the WISDOM entrance on the plaza, and a 16-storey Sixth Avenue wing in the same pier language. Pale white_terracotta Art Deco slab fluted by continuous 1-block piers and dark recessed window strips (about 1 in 7 lit), with N/S setback ledges, floodlit crown, Top of the Rock glass-parapet decks, a red GE sign and a mast. East face has the three portals under the WISDOM relief. The low Sixth Avenue wing has lit shopfronts and planted roofs.
elements.md lists 21 elements, and plan.md now has the palette, 18 vocab helpers, rooms and 8 parts.

rooms.name: Tower lobby (behind east portals)
rooms.purpose: Tall lit Art Deco lobby seen through the three portals and glass screen: polished stone floor, shroomlight ceiling, bronze (polished_blackstone) piers, a central info desk; mood warm and grand at dusk. Show-through only.
rooms.ways_in: East portals x144 at z21..23, z26..29, z32..34 (y3..9); north entrance x71..76 at z0..3 via the marquee passage

rooms.name: Sixth Avenue shop strip
rooms.purpose: Row of lit shops 6 deep behind the Sixth Ave glass: counters and displays, warm light; the main entrance hall at z24..29 is a lit lobby with a desk.
rooms.ways_in: Sixth Ave main entrance x0, z24..29, y1..8; shop doors every 3rd bay

rooms.name: 50th Street shop podium
rooms.purpose: Shallow lit shops under the N1 podium (3 storeys, one tall storey to y10), shop windows displaying goods; garden roof above.
rooms.ways_in: Shop doors on z0 every 3rd bay; tower north entrance at x71..76

rooms.name: 49th Street passage and shop strip
rooms.purpose: Lit passage hall from the 49th St entrance into the base, flanked by shops 6 deep behind the south glass.
rooms.ways_in: 49th St passage entrance z51, x96..103, y2..8; shop doors every 3rd bay

rooms.name: Plaza-end corner pavilions
rooms.purpose: Small glazed lit kiosks at the plaza corners (E6): a counter and a display of goods, seen from the plaza.
rooms.ways_in: Doors x145 at z13..14 and z41..42, y3..6 (south pavilion box mirrors at z40..43)

rooms.name: Forecourt kiosk P1
rooms.purpose: Glazed lit kiosk on the 49th St forecourt with a small counter and a bench.
rooms.ways_in: Glazed door on its east side at x7, z50..51, y1..3

parts.name: Massing and shell
parts.scope: All architect boxes (I1-I4, C1, F1-F6, E1-E6, W1-W5, N1, P1, LC) as hollow shells with groundDown plinths. Floors at the lobby (y3) and shop storeys. Reserved cells and openings are left air. Vocab: box, groundDown.

parts.name: Tower facades
parts.scope: The fluting grammar on all faces of the tower masses, with lit-window scatter. Tower base shop storey up to y14 with shopBay. Vocab: flute, windowCell, shopBay.

parts.name: Wings and shopfronts
parts.scope: Fluting and shopBay on W1-W5, N1, E6 and P1. The Sixth Ave and 49th St portals. Wing parapets, with roof lights. Vocab: flute, windowCell, shopBay, portal, parapet.

parts.name: Setbacks, decks and crown
parts.scope: Every ledge deck with stair coping and shroomlight floodlights (y196 up, plus the lower ledges). Top of the Rock glass-pane parapets on I3 (y224) and I4 (y228). C1 roof at y232, penthouse x96..119 z25..30 y233..236, mast x107..108 z27..28, lightning_rod at y244. Vocab: ledge, deckParapet, mast.

parts.name: GE crown sign
parts.scope: Red GE letters on the N face z12 and S face z43, x76..103, y197..209, backed by shroomlight. Everything else in the band white_terracotta. Vocab: geSign (via plaque).

parts.name: East entrance, marquee and flags
parts.scope: Three portals, glass-block screen, WISDOM inscription band, the WISDOM relief panel, the north marquee x68..79 z0..3 y12..15, and flag rows over all four entrances. Vocab: portal, glassScreen, wisdomPanel, marquee, flagRow.

parts.name: Roof gardens and grounds
parts.scope: Gardens on W2 (y41), N1 (y11) and LC (y12), with forecourt paving and street lamp posts. Vocab: gardenBed, paving, lampPost.

parts.name: Lamplighting and checks
parts.scope: Fill hidden light so every deck, terrace and roof has light 8 or more, then run $MCD light and $MCD check (nothing floating, nothing outside the footprint, y245 cap).

recruit.why: Limestone shell, plinths, piers and string courses with corners as solid piers
Window strips, shop glazing, portals and the glass-block screen
GE letters and the WISDOM inscription read correctly from the street
Flat roofs, parapets and setback decks with copings
Floodlit crown, lit windows and lobbies, and no dark deck
Roof gardens, forecourt paving and lamp posts
The WISDOM panel in gold and terracotta
